prompt: WebRTC remote MediaStreamTrack applyConstraints rejection error
answer:
For a remote `MediaStreamTrack` sourced from an `RTCPeerConnection`, `applyConstraints()` is specified to **always reject with `OverconstrainedError`**. Its constraints are not applied to the remote track; remote-track settings represent the frames or samples currently being received, potentially after downsampling.

The same specification states that `getCapabilities()` for remote tracks must return an empty set. (W3C WebRTC PR #2188: https://github.com/w3c/webrtc-pc/pull/2188/files#1)
